reviewer: Project author, after the browser verdict. This is a reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: Escape now only closes the list, which is the default the maintainer proposes in #485.
caveats: The clear event is no longer emitted on Escape; code that listened for it there will not be called.
#485 also proposes a clearOnEscape option for the old behaviour; the patch does not add it, so an upstream pull request would need that option.
